scientific_integrity: The complete Jordan form and resulting temporal counts are derived algebraically. Computational comparisons are explicitly bounded to tested graph sizes; no untested finite output is presented as an exhaustive theorem.
scientific_limitations: The proof treats only synchronous self-exclusive neighbor-XOR over the binary field on complete bipartite graphs modified by a single internal edge in a shore of size at least three; the opposite shore has size at least two.
The proof uses elementary Jordan/Fitting decomposition; finite enumeration checks indexing but does not constitute a proof of the all-size theorem.
Historical priority is not guaranteed against unindexed publications or equivalent older graph-defect calculations. No independent expert audit or validation was performed.
title: One triangle edge switches the Jordan phase of biclique parity dynamics
